officialRates.title: Official Dental Procedure Rates
officialRates.subtitle: Data sourced from ministries and dental associations
officialRates.note1: Official rates are based on data from national dental associations.
officialRates.note2: Community rates are calculated from anonymous user declarations.
officialRates.note3: The ratio shows the percentage of the official rate represented by the community rate.
officialRates.note4: This data is for informational purposes only and does not replace medical or dental advice.

communityRates.title: Tooth Fairy Community Rates
communityRates.subtitle: Average amounts left by the Tooth Fairy, based on user declarations
communityRates.howItWorks1: Amounts are calculated from the median of user declarations.
communityRates.howItWorks2: The confidence score depends on sample size, data recency, and amount dispersion.
communityRates.howItWorks3: Data is anonymized and moderated to prevent abuse.
communityRates.howItWorks4: Amounts are displayed in the country's local currency.
communityRates.disclaimer: This data is community-powered and may not reflect official reality. It is provided for informational and entertainment purposes only.

croq.whatAreCroqDescription: CROQ Credits are virtual credits awarded to users for their participation in The Tooth Fairy Exchange project.
croq.howToEarn1: Declare an amount for the Tooth Fairy (+10 to 50 CROQ).
croq.howToEarn3: Contribute to moderation or translations (+20 to 200 CROQ).
croq.howToEarn5: Share the Service with friends (+20 CROQ per signup).
croq.howToUse2: Participate in special lotteries or games.
croq.disclaimer: ⚠️ CROQ Credits are not a cryptocurrency, have no monetary value, cannot be bought or sold, and do not entitle you to any return. A potential CROQ token has not yet been launched.
